interpretation_guardrail: KNN measures the composition of all-strut neighborhoods around saved unintended missing/broken candidates. It does not classify defects, assign clusters, or establish manufacturing causation. Present struts dominate the lattice, so interpret observed percentages relative to the nulls.

models.all_strut_label_permutation: Keep unintended missing/broken source locations fixed and permute the six neighborhood labels across all strut locations while preserving global category counts.
models.boundary_orientation_stratified_all_stru: Keep source locations fixed and permute all-strut neighborhood labels only within boundary-bin × orientation strata.
